verdict.rationale: LegalZoom documents recurring automation it runs on the user's behalf: auto-filing of annual reports and Compliance Calendar reminders for upcoming deadlines. It does not document any user-facing way to define, schedule, or configure their own recurring jobs or workflows. missing for 10: user-configurable scheduling of arbitrary recurring jobs/workflows, programmatic or AI-driven scheduling controls, documentation of schedule management (frequency, triggers, editing), independent corroboration.
